posts.description: A strict Content Security Policy (img-src self or stricter) will conflict with out-of-the-box Bootstrap CSS files, as they contain inline image data. Below is a table matching raw image data from the CSS to the corresponding SVG file name. posts.title: Folia - our new engine
posts.description: Bye bye Jekyll… welcome Folia! Finally got tired of Jekyll enough to… fully vibe-code an alternative that better fits this website: Rust-based, built with Dioxus, supports multiple publishing modes (blog and microblog posts, digital garden, pages, …) out-of-the-box.
